text:
Nia: Helena from EuropaPay uploaded their SIG export and a short cover note. They want a 10-day POC that touches tokenized payment identifiers and EU-only processing. link: https://files.redwood.example/europay/sig_2026_q2.pdf
DeployBot: File stored at secure-bucket://intake/europay/3478509012/sig.pdf (sha256: e7b1c...) :white_check_mark:
Helena (EuropaPay): Hi team 10 business days POC. We'll provide anonymized tokens (no PAN). EU-only processing required, prefer BYOK for keys. Need a ballpark Dedicated estimate and whether a hosted eval (with BYOK) is possible.
Marco (SE): Hosted w/ customer-managed keys is technically possible in eu-west-1, but legal will need to confirm DPA language. For Dedicated we can provision a small pool; need expected QPS and latency targets to size.
Nia: Can EuropaPay confirm steady QPS, peak, and p95 target? Also confirm context length for requests.
Helena (EuropaPay): Steady ~12 req/s, peaks ~70 req/s. p95 target < 220ms. Contexts short, ~1k tokens. We'll upload a network diagram and sample anonymized token set by EOD.
Priya (Security): I'll take ownership of the CAIQ pass. Things I need: network diagram, list of PII fields in the POC, deployment model confirmation, and any sections they left as "customer input". If BYOK + EU-only then LegalBot must review DPA before we start.
LegalBot: Confirmed: BYOK or explicit EU-only processing requires DPA + subprocessors check. Opening legal ticket #LEGAL-3184. No POC start until legal ok on short-term eval terms if keys are customer-managed.
Marco (SE): For quick sizing: Dedicated suggestion 3xA10 for consistent p95 and headroom during spikes; rough short-term commit estimate $12k/month prorated for the 10 days + engineer support. Hosted eval with BYOK would likely be cheaper but depends on legal timeline. I'll drop a spreadsheet.
Helena (EuropaPay): Can retention on logs be minimized for the POC? Compliance wants 30 days if possible.
Priya (Security): We can propose 30-day retention for the POC; will document in CAIQ answers. Also will mark control owners as "redwood-inference" where applicable and flag high-risk controls.
Nia: I'll set up a kickoff tomorrow 9am CET. Attendees: @Marco, @Priya, Legal rep, and EuropaPay contacts. Agenda: confirm artifacts, BYOK onboarding steps, VPC peering (if private), timeline and estimate.
Helena (EuropaPay): 9am CET works. We'll upload the network diagram and sample tokens before the call.
DeployBot: Intake ticket #SF-5104 created and linked to this thread.
Priya (Security): Starting a preliminary questionnaire pass now and will post inline comments + a short artifact checklist before the call.
Nia: Thanks all 1 will update the CRM stage to "security intake -> assigned" and follow up after kickoff. :thumbsup:
